subject: SSO login fails for whole team
body: Since about 08:00 UTC none of our 231 users can sign in through Okta SSO. They are redirected back with a 502 error on the callback page. This blocks our whole logistics operation. Please treat this as urgent.

subject: Refund: charged for 8 seats, we only use 5
body: Our last invoice charged us for 8 seats but only 5 people actually use CloudDesk. We removed three people in October and expected the bill to drop. Can we get a refund for the 3 unused seats for this billing period?

subject: API returns 429 during nightly sync
body: Our nightly sync job started getting HTTP 429 responses around 02:00 UTC. It worked fine until last week. We call the files endpoint roughly 800 times in ten minutes. What is the limit and how do we avoid hitting it?

subject: Uploads fail: storage quota exceeded
body: Every upload to our photo archive now fails with 'storage quota exceeded'. We are on Pro. Our shoots are big, so I need to know what our limit is and what the cheapest way to get more space is.

subject: Suspicious logins - possible breach
body: We received login alerts for three of our partners from IP addresses in countries where we have no staff, at 03:10 and 03:12 UTC. Two of those accounts have access to privileged client matters. We think an account may have been compromised. What should we do?

subject: Files disappeared from the Clinic Records folder
body: About 340 patient scan files that were in Clinic Records/2026/Q3 yesterday are gone this morning. Nobody on our team admits deleting them. We need them back today for a regulatory inspection.

subject: Cannot share a folder with an external client
body: When I try to share the Proposals folder with a client who is not on our workspace, the share button says external sharing is not available. How can I send them access?

subject: Slack integration stopped posting alerts
body: Our #data-alerts Slack channel has not received any CloudDesk notifications since Monday. The integration still shows as connected in settings. Nothing changed on our side that we know of.

subject: Delete legacy workspace and erase all its data
body: Please permanently delete the workspace 'Legacy Reports 2021' and erase all data in it, including backups, under our right to erasure. The matter is closed and we no longer have a legal basis to keep the files.

subject: Dark mode request
body: Love the product. Any chance you could add a dark mode to the web app? My eyes would thank you.

subject: Unauthorized charge - we are disputing it with our bank
body: There is a charge of 375.00 USD from CloudDesk on our card dated 20 November that nobody here authorised. We have started a dispute with our bank. Please confirm what this charge is.

subject: Locked out after too many MFA attempts
body: I entered the wrong MFA code a few times and now my account says it is locked. I changed phones and cannot get codes from my old authenticator app. How do I get back in?
